title: Digital anxiety therapy study
summary: We plan to include 30 patients with social phobia, panic disorder and/or agoraphobia in our study. We want to investigate if a digital health app that is used by the patients at their own discretion could be a valuable addition to inpatient/day clinic psychiatric treatment. Apart from clinical effects, we aim to investigate if the digital health app fulfils the users‘ (therapists and patients) expectations.
conditions: Agoraphobia: Without indication of a panic disorder

interventions.name: inpatient/day clinic treatment plus digital health app

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
patients currently in inpatient or day clinic treatment at the study centre
presence of primary or comorbid agora phobia, social phobia or panic disorder
Exclusion criteria:
• acute suicidality
• primary psychotic disorder
• posttraumatic stress disorder
• other psychiatric condition that currently precludes treatment of the anxiety disorder
• severe somatic condition (if contraindication for exposure therapy)
• epilepsy or other CNS disorder
• in women: pregnancy
during the current course of treatment, the patient has already conducted therapist-instructed exposure exercises (with or without the presence of the therapist)
